platformWorkbench.heroTitle: From Prompt + Skill manager to an AI operations workspace
platformWorkbench.heroDesc: This prototype explores how GuiZhi could grow into a unified platform for prompts, skills, agents, MCP integrations and execution history without forcing everything into the current two-mode shell.
platformWorkbench.sidebarFootDesc: Main navigation shifts from object count to domain structure: assets, automations, integrations and operations.
platformWorkbench.libraryTitle: Prompts, skills and reusable building blocks
platformWorkbench.libraryDesc: Content assets and reusable capabilities live in the same workspace, but remain clearly typed and searchable.
platformWorkbench.agentsDesc: Agents should sit beside skills, with explicit runtime, ownership and safety metadata instead of being hidden inside loose prompt conventions.
platformWorkbench.mcpTitle: External tools are managed as connections, not content
platformWorkbench.mcpDesc: MCP servers, model gateways and sync endpoints belong in a dedicated integration surface with health, auth and environment context.
platformWorkbench.operationsDesc: Once Prompt, Skill, Agent and MCP all coexist, users need a unified surface for runs, failures, audits and release readiness.
platformWorkbench.laneSkillsHint: Reusable capability packages and project skills
platformWorkbench.laneResourcesHint: Reference docs, context packs, imported files
platformWorkbench.laneMcpServersHint: Tool adapters, execution endpoints, repo bridges
platformWorkbench.laneProvidersHint: AI gateways, inference vendors, fallback chains
platformWorkbench.laneSyncHint: Backups, publishing targets and workspace mirrors
platformWorkbench.laneRunsHint: Recent tasks, jobs and automated sequences
platformWorkbench.laneAuditHint: Security checks, publish reviews and quality gates
platformWorkbench.laneReleasesHint: Version plans, rollout state and rollback safety
platformWorkbench.emptySearch: No prototype items match the current search.
platformWorkbench.whyLibrary: Prompts and skills can still feel familiar, but they no longer need to shoulder every future object type in the product.
platformWorkbench.whyAgents: Agents deserve their own lifecycle, observability and guardrails instead of being buried as prompt conventions or skill metadata hacks.
platformWorkbench.whyMcp: MCP and provider configuration is operational infrastructure. Treating it as a connection surface keeps auth, health and environment concerns explicit.
platformWorkbench.whyOperations: As the platform grows, users need a home for runs, audits and release status that cuts across every resource type.
platformWorkbench.noteDesc: This page is intentionally driven by mock structure. The goal is to preview a scalable navigation and workspace shape before migrating the real Prompt / Skill shell.

settings.backupRestoreConfirmMessage: All current data will be replaced with the backup from {{time}}. A snapshot of the current data is saved automatically before restoring. The app restarts when done.
settings.mcpLoadFailed: Failed to load MCP integration details.
settings.mcpDesc: Once connected, Cursor, Codex and other AI tools can search and read your knowledge base directly — no need to copy content out of GuiZhi first. GuiZhi does not have to be running, and only two read-only tools are exposed; nothing can be modified or deleted.
settings.mcpMissing: MCP server component not found. On a development build, run pnpm build first; on an installed build this means the package is incomplete — update or reinstall.
settings.mcpScopeDesc: The AI only sees collections allowed here. Changes take effect immediately, no IDE restart needed.
settings.mcpScopeAllDesc: Collections created later are included automatically
settings.mcpScopeSelectedDesc: Only ticked collections are visible to the AI
settings.mcpScopeEmptyWarning: Nothing is ticked: the AI will find nothing at all.
settings.mcpScopeSaveFailed: Failed to save the access scope
settings.mcpInstallHint: Merges GuiZhi into that client's config file. Your other MCP servers and any comments you wrote are kept, and a backup is saved before overwriting.
settings.mcpInstallWritten: Written to the {{client}} config — restart {{client}} to apply
settings.mcpInstallUpdated: Updated the GuiZhi entry in {{client}} — restart {{client}} to apply
settings.mcpSnippetCommand: Command line (recommended, writes the config for you)
settings.mcpSnippetToml: Or add it to config.toml by hand
settings.mcpCursorLocation: Global config lives at ~/.cursor/mcp.json; a project-level .cursor/mcp.json also works.
settings.mcpCursorPitfall: After editing the file by hand, refresh once in Cursor's MCP panel before it connects.
settings.mcpCodexLocation: Global config lives at ~/.codex/config.toml; a project-level .codex/config.toml only applies to trusted projects.
settings.mcpCodexPitfall: Codex uses TOML, and the key is mcp_servers with an underscore. Copying the JSON-style mcpServers makes the whole block silently ignored.
settings.exportMarkdownDesc: Exports all items as .md files with metadata, grouped by collection — ready for Obsidian and similar tools
settings.aiWorkbenchRouteEmbeddingDesc: Vector model for semantic search; without it, search falls back to full-text only.
settings.aiWorkbenchRouteAudioTextDesc: Speech-to-text model for audio/video (e.g. whisper-1, via /audio/transcriptions).
settings.aiWorkbenchRouteImageGenDesc: Text-to-image model used to illustrate item bodies (e.g. gpt-image-2, gemini-3-pro-image).
settings.autoBackupRunning: Auto backup in progress; the app may briefly stop responding…
settings.configExportDesc: Writes every app setting to a single JSON file: AI endpoints and models, model routes, illustration styles, shortcuts, appearance and general preferences. API keys can be encrypted and included.
settings.configExportSubtitle: Write this device's entire configuration to a JSON file, then import it on the new machine.
settings.configExportIncludeKeysDesc: When off, only endpoint URLs, names and routes are exported; keys are left blank and must be filled in after importing.
settings.configExportPasswordHint: Keys are encrypted with this password before being written; the rest of the file stays readable plain text. The password is only needed at import time — GuiZhi never stores it and cannot recover it.
settings.configExportPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters
settings.configExportScopeNote: Not included: data directory, yt-dlp and ffmpeg paths, launch at startup, background image, and the local transcription engine — those are bound to this machine. Knowledge items travel via Local backup instead.
settings.configImportDesc: Restore settings from a configuration file exported on another device. You'll see a summary of the file's contents before anything is replaced.
settings.configImportRowKeysAbsent: Not included — fill them in after importing
settings.configImportWarning: Every setting on this machine will be replaced by this file, including configured API keys. A snapshot of the config directory is taken first. The app restarts once the import finishes.

library.illustrationStyleEditorSubtitle: A style only decides how images look, not which paragraphs get illustrated. Takes effect as soon as you save.

library.illustrationStyleVisualDnaRequired: Look and palette cannot be empty — it is the body of the image prompt
library.illustrationStyleCharacterHint: A character that appears in every image and carries the main action. Leave empty to require no character.
library.illustrationStyleNegativeHint: Looks to rule out, also appended to the prompt. "No charts" is built in — no need to repeat it here.
library.illustrationStyleAspectHint: Only some models can actually produce 16:9
library.illustrationStyleMaxShotsHint: Upper bound of the count picker
library.illustrationStyleMaxLabelsHint: Models misspell Chinese labels — fewer is safer

library.illustrationStyleExportHint: Copies it as JSON you can send to someone
library.illustrationStyleExported: Style JSON copied to the clipboard
library.illustrationStyleImportHint: Paste the style JSON someone sent you; a single entry from a preset file works too.
library.illustrationStyleImportIncomplete: Name and look-and-palette are both required

library.illustrationStyleRestoreMessage: The current list will be replaced by the built-in styles and your edits will be lost. Nothing is written to disk until you save.
library.illustrationStyleRevealHint: Presets live in config/illustration-styles.json and can be edited by hand
library.illustrationStyleSuggested: Having read the article, the model thinks "{{name}}" fits it better: {{description}}

library.illustrationEmpty: First let the text model read the body, pick the paragraphs worth illustrating and describe each shot. This step draws nothing and costs almost nothing.

setup.title: Get started with GuiZhi
setup.intro: You can capture and full-text search without models. Configure the items below to unlock summaries, Q&A, transcription, and semantic search.
setup.itemTextModelDesc: Q&A, summaries, Wiki compile, and video summaries need a main or fast text model.
setup.itemTranscriptionDesc: Install the local transcription engine, or configure the audioText route under Model Services.
setup.itemYtdlpDesc: Needed for Bilibili and YouTube. Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and regular web pages do not require it.
setup.itemEmbeddingDesc: Full-text search still works without it; embedding improves Q&A recall.
setup.openFromAboutDesc: Review the checklist for text models and capture tools again

imports.authenticatedWarningPresent: Authenticated capture completed with a non-blocking warning
imports.transcriptionFailure403: Transcript could not be generated: the platform denied audio access (HTTP 403). The video may require login, be private, or the platform may be temporarily limiting parsing. Confirm the link opens while signed out, then retry later.
imports.transcriptionFailure401: Transcript could not be generated: the platform requires login for audio access (HTTP 401). Confirm that the video is public, or import a local file instead.
imports.transcriptionFailure404: Transcript could not be generated: the audio resource is unavailable (HTTP 404). The video may have been deleted, taken down, or the link has expired.
imports.transcriptionFailure429: Transcript could not be generated: the platform is temporarily limiting audio access (HTTP 429). Retry later and avoid submitting it repeatedly.
